gloss: reduced service (of trains/buses); thinning out scheduled runs

definitions.gloss: reduced service; thinning out scheduled runs (trains, buses)
definitions.explanation: The practice of operating fewer trains or buses than usual on a given line, either due to disruption (bad weather, accidents, equipment trouble) or due to planned reductions in service (lower demand, staff shortages).

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{間引|まび}き{運転|うんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}している→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧。
examples.english: We are operating reduced service because of the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{間引|まび}き{運転|うんてん}になっている⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please note that the trains are running on a reduced schedule.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦{時間帯|じかんたい}→時間帯：12971_jikantai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{間引|まび}き{運転|うんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Due to the heavy snow, reduced service was in effect during the morning commute.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運転士|うんてんし}→運転士：07339_untenshi⟧{不足|ぶそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{間引|まび}き{運転|うんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Due to a shortage of drivers, reduced service continues on some lines.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{間引|まび}き→間引き：21566_mabiki⟧ (thinning out) + ⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧ (operation, running). The verb ⟦{間引|まび}く→間引く：08233_mabiku⟧ originally refers to thinning out seedlings in a garden — removing some so that the rest have room to grow — and is used metaphorically to describe removing scheduled runs from a transit timetable.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {間引|まび}き{運転|うんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧: to implement reduced service
- {間引|まび}き{運転|うんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to operate on a reduced schedule
- {間引|まび}き{運転|うんてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to go on a reduced schedule
- {間引|まび}き{運転|うんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: reduced service continues
- ⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦{区間|くかん}→区間：18759_kukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{間引|まび}き{運転|うんてん}: reduced service on a partial section of the line

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{運休|うんきゅう}→運休：06807_unkyuu⟧: service suspension — more extreme; no runs at all
- ⟦{遅延|ちえん}→遅延：06749_chien⟧: delay — trains still run but behind schedule
- ⟦{折返|おりかえ}し{運転|うんてん}→折返し運転：23323_orikaeshiunten⟧: shuttle operation — trains turn back partway due to a blocked section
- ⟦{徐行|じょこう}→徐行：09215_jokou⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧: slow operation — trains run at reduced speed
- ⟦{平常|へいじょう}→平常：25319_heijou⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧: normal operation — the baseline

USAGE:
{間引|まび}き{運転|うんてん} is one of several standard railway terms heard in Japanese station announcements and news reports during service disruptions. Passengers expect longer waits between trains on the affected line.
